description: Code-to-rule map for every diagnostic code the reference prototype (reference/prototype/checker.py, coloured.py, durable.py), the P0 implementations (crates/weave-syntax, crates/weave-check, crates/weave-eval and scripts/p0_reference.py; codes E500-E540), the modules-1 implementations (crates/weave-check, the agent kit's use net support and scripts/modules_conformance.py; codes E600-E619) and the agent kit (agent-kit/.agents/skills/weave/scripts/) can emit. Each code has exactly one principal rule and optional secondary rules. Category 'specification': rule IDs from rules.json. Category 'kit-extension': rule IDs of the agent kit's pure fn extension, defined in agent-kit/docs/weave.md, outside the specified fragment. Category 'tool': not a language diagnostic; rule is null. related_roles maps each related-span role a diagnostic of that code can carry to 'always' or to the condition under which it is present. scripts/refresh_reference_pages.py generates the tables in docs/chapters/diagnostics.rst from this file; agent-kit/.agents/skills/weave/assets/diagnostics.json is a byte-identical copy.

categories.specification: Language diagnostic of the reference prototype or of a P0 implementation; the rule is a rule ID in rules.json
categories.kit-extension: Diagnostic of the agent kit's pure fn extension; the rule is a kit rule ID defined in agent-kit/docs/weave.md
categories.tool: Runner failure outside the checker; no rule applies

E001.meaning: Tab, invalid indentation, skipped level, unexpected block
E001.correction: Use four spaces and a valid block header

E002.meaning: Invalid type, parameter, brackets, or comma list
E002.correction: Use nominal types and identifier indices

E003.meaning: Duplicate/invalid net declaration, unexpected nested content, or a duplicated match case tag
E003.correction: Check declaration grammar and uniqueness; name each match case once

E100.correction: Make signatures, issuers, cancellations, and arcs agree

E101.meaning: Unauthorized resource/runtime consumption or activation read
E101.correction: Use only declared consumers; do not bypass sealing

E110.correction: Restrict names and integer arithmetic appropriately

E111.correction: Correct initialization or the intended equality

E112.correction: Correct the transition or revisit the contract explicitly
E112.note: Preservation by every transition column is defined in verification.rst, Aggregate invariants, which has no rule ID of its own.

E200.meaning: Invalid flow declaration or unsupported statement

E201.correction: Supply all required arguments, including permits

E202.meaning: Discarded non-Unit result or resource payload

E203.meaning: Use after move or double consumption
E203.correction: Transfer each live linear binding once

E204.meaning: Live linear obligations at normal/propagated return
E204.correction: Consume, hand off, or return them on every path

related_roles.propagation: only when the return was generated by '?'

E205.meaning: Attempt to construct a sealed resource
E205.correction: Obtain it from its authorized issuer API

E206.correction: Use an exported API or same-file helper

E208.meaning: Wrong nominal type, arity, or unresolved call identity

E209.correction: Use the permit belonging to the requested identity

E210.note: SYN-12 (Flow control) states this check: every path terminates and no statement follows a return. SYN-10 governs how a return is interpreted, which E217 enforces.

E212.correction: Use the supported awaited call form

E213.correction: Match a live enum at the end of the block

E214.meaning: Missing or undeclared match cases (a case tag written twice reports E003)
E214.correction: Cover exactly the declared case set

E215.correction: End with return or exhaustive terminal match
E215.note: SYN-12 (Flow control) states this check: every path terminates and no statement follows a return. SYN-10 governs how a return is interpreted, which E217 enforces.

E216.correction: Bind result indices and use supported types

E218.correction: Use an acyclic F0 call graph

E219.correction: Use a case of that result

E320.correction: Inspect the trace and repair the protocol

E321.correction: Report NOT ESTABLISHED; review the model and limits

E400.meaning: Invalid coloured syntax, sorts, or model
E400.correction: Preserve colour arity and required declarations

E411.correction: Use valid per-colour or aggregate accounting

E420.note: durable.py also reports E420 when the R0 model refuses a cross-order firing.

E422.correction: Report NOT ESTABLISHED, not successful verification

E500.meaning: Invalid P0 pure-file syntax: a lexical fault, input the pure-file grammar does not derive, a word other than await before a qualified name, or nesting beyond the parser's limit
E500.correction: Use only P0 syntax (fn and record declarations)

E501.meaning: Duplicate top-level name, or a function or record named like a built-in name
E501.correction: Give each function and record a distinct, non-built-in name

E502.meaning: Duplicate field name in a record declaration

E503.meaning: Recursive record type: a record reaches itself through its field types
E503.correction: Remove the cycle; P0 has no recursive records

E504.meaning: Type outside P0: a handle or other indexed nominal type, an unknown type name, or a malformed List type
E504.correction: Use Int, Bool, List[T] or a record declared in the file

E505.meaning: Unknown name, or a function, record or primitive name used as a value
E505.correction: Refer to a parameter, an earlier let binding, true or false

E506.meaning: Shadowing: a parameter or let binding reuses a name already in scope, a top-level name or a built-in name

E507.meaning: Unknown call target, wrong argument count, or wrong argument form (named and positional arguments)
E507.correction: Call a declared function, primitive or record with its arguments

E508.meaning: Record construction does not name every field exactly once
E508.correction: Name every declared field once, and no other

E509.meaning: Field access on a value that is not a record, or of a field the record does not declare
E509.correction: Access a declared field of a record-typed binding

E510.meaning: Type mismatch in an operand, argument, condition, list element or returned value
E510.correction: Make the expression's type match the expected type

E511.meaning: Empty list literal without an expected list type
E511.correction: Use [] where a List type is expected, such as a return or an argument

E512.meaning: Qualified call in pure code: a net, foreign or flow operation
E512.correction: Perform effects in a flow; pure code calls only functions, primitives and records

E513.correction: Pure code does not wait; move the operation to a flow

E514.correction: P0 is sequential; call the functions one after the other

E515.meaning: A block does not end in return or a terminal if/else, an if has no else, or a statement follows a return or if
E515.correction: End every block with return or with if/else whose blocks both end

E516.meaning: Mutual recursion: a call cycle through two or more functions

E520.meaning: Division or remainder by zero at run time (pure fault)
E520.correction: Test the divisor before calling div or mod

E521.meaning: head or tail of an empty list at run time (pure fault)
E521.correction: Test is_empty before head or tail

E530.meaning: Fuel budget exhausted: too many user-function calls
E530.correction: Raise the fuel budget, or check termination; fuel is not a termination proof

E531.meaning: Depth budget exhausted: too many active function calls
E531.correction: Raise the depth budget or reduce recursion depth

E532.meaning: Integer size budget exhausted: an integer needs more bits than the budget
E532.correction: Raise the integer size budget or keep values smaller

E540.meaning: Invalid run request: unknown entry function, or arguments that do not match its parameters
E540.correction: Name a declared function and pass one JSON value of the right type per parameter

E600.meaning: Invalid modules-1 header syntax: a malformed import declaration, or one after the first declaration, in a module file; or a malformed use net header in a flow file
E600.correction: Write imports as 'from a.b import x, y as z', one per line before the first declaration, and the header as 'use net a.b' before the first flow

E601.meaning: No module file: a module path names no file <root>/a/b.weave under the project root
E601.correction: Create the module file, or correct the path; paths resolve from the project root, never from the working directory

E602.meaning: A module path differs in case from the directory or file names on disk
E602.correction: Spell each segment exactly as the directory or file is named

E603.meaning: A module path leaves the project root once symbolic links are resolved
E603.correction: Keep every module, and every directory on its path, inside the project root

E604.meaning: Import cycle: this import closes a cycle of imports (including a module importing itself); cross-module recursion and record cycles always need one
E604.correction: Move the shared declarations into a module that both import

E605.meaning: No project root: an import in a file read without a project root, or an entry file outside the project root given with --root
E605.correction: Give the project root with --root, or check a file inside it

E606.meaning: An imported name is not a function or record declared in the named module
E606.correction: Import a declaration the module declares; imports are selective and there are no wildcards

E607.meaning: An imported declaration is not marked export in its module
E607.correction: Mark the declaration export in its module, or do not import it

E608.meaning: An import name collides with a built-in name, another import or a declaration of the importing module
E608.correction: Rename the import with 'as'; imports never shadow and are never shadowed

E609.meaning: An exported declaration names, in its signature or field types, a record that is not exported
E609.correction: Export the record too, or do not export the declaration

E610.meaning: A flow's use net header and the --net argument select different nets
E610.correction: Drop --net, or make it name the header's net file

P400.meaning: Unsupported or malformed pure syntax, operators, or declarations
P400.correction: Use only the constructs of the pure extension

P401.meaning: Unsupported type, including linear resources, in a pure signature
P401.correction: Use Int, Bool, IntList or IntListPair

P402.correction: Give each function and parameter its own name

P403.meaning: Unknown binding, or a function used as a value
P403.correction: Bind the name first; call functions instead of passing them

P404.correction: Declare the function or use a listed primitive

P406.meaning: Wrong argument type, including a <= operand
P406.correction: Pass values of the declared types

P407.correction: Return a value of the declared return type

P408.meaning: Malformed branch: missing else, statements after return or if, or a path without return
P408.correction: End every path with return or a terminal if/else

P409.meaning: Illegal effect: await, a net or foreign operation, or a flow call

P410.meaning: Flow declared in a pure program
P410.correction: Put flows and pure functions in separate files

P412.correction: Write two branches that call user functions and do not read each other

P420.meaning: head or tail of an empty list at run time
P420.correction: Test is_empty before head or tail

P424.meaning: Entry arguments are not valid JSON of the declared types
P424.correction: Pass a JSON array matching the entry signature

P426.correction: Report it as a kit defect

P427.meaning: Internal fork/join pairing error; never expected
P427.correction: Report it as a kit defect

TOOL_ERROR.meaning: The agent-kit runner failed outside the checker: unreadable input, invalid usage, a scenario or runtime-model assertion, or a timeout
TOOL_ERROR.correction: Fix the input or invocation; this is not a language diagnostic
